    Propolis
    
              
    Pure propolis produced by Ionian honey bees, prepared as an ethanol extract. Ethanol extraction dissolves the bioactive compounds — flavonoids and polyphenols — at the highest yield while removing waxes, making its antioxidant and antimicrobial action stronger and more bioavailable. Supports the immune system and soothes throat discomfort.
